The first critic's sample (59) was aimed at suspects and gives no rate. Where the source is not stored here, a critic's check was memory against memory.

## Summary and what was read

A mind is what an environment makes of ancient drive systems: narrative is the drive's interface, stories behave as attractors, optimizing for attention selects the fastest. Most of the psychology has no home: 03's Open names motivation, affect, perception and attention as unreached. Where the account comes near it holds forms on small models, and joining those forms to drives, stories and minds is mostly this crosswalk's proposal, not the account's; agreement with a checked law's form is rare. Live readings that touch the source (one record on its 理 sentence, 02 and 07 on capture) descend from the corpus's own line. Divergences: no closing is called evil, formed is kept apart from having reasons behind it, "truth only intersubjective" and a default purpose are taken otherwise, 心 as root meets a live defeater, a basin's depth and width lie outside the theorems, and a way of seeing alone is scoped.
